description: This Java class 'ThingEventPubSubFactory' provides factory methods for creating pub-sub (publish-subscribe) instances tailored for 'ThingEvent' objects within an actor-based system, supporting different configurations such as shard-aware, read-subject only, or shard ID only.

classes.name: ThingEventPubSubFactory
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPubSubFactory, responsible for creating pub-sub instances for 'ThingEvent' with various configurations in an actor-based system.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a pubsub factory using an actor context and shard region extractor.

methods.name: readSubjectsOnly
methods.description: Static factory method to create a pubsub factory that reads only subjects, ignoring shard IDs.

methods.name: shardIdOnly
methods.description: Static factory method to create a pubsub factory that considers only shard IDs, based on a specified number of shards.

methods.name: readSubjectOnlyExtractor
methods.description: Private static method returning a topic extractor configured to only extract read subjects with a predefined constant topic prefix.

methods.name: shardIdOnlyExtractor
methods.description: Private static method returning a topic extractor configured for shard ID extraction.

methods.name: toTopicExtractor
methods.description: Private static method to create a combined topic extractor incorporating constant topics and shard ID extraction based on a shard region extractor.
